turnaround_reason: Blue-chip animal-health leader down ~43-47% to a record-low ~11x P/E on Librela (osteoarthritis mAb) safety/FDA adverse-event fallout and Apoquel/parasiticide share loss to Elanco's Zenrelia; the underlying franchise remains highly profitable.
bullish_points: Elite economics intact: gross margin 72%, operating margin 41%, profit margin 28%, FCF ~$2B
Trailing/forward P/E ~11-12 — the lowest in company history vs a historical 30-40x range; analyst 'buy', mean target $96 (+~32%)
Director insider buying ~$0.9M in May 2026 at $75-78 (D'Amelio, McCallister, Bisaro); Michael Burry reportedly doubling down
Librela revenue rose sequentially for the first time in six quarters; livestock +12% organic — diversification is working
bearish_points: Librela safety overhang is real: FDA-flagged neurologic adverse events (ataxia, seizures, deaths) drove a 16% 2025 sales drop
Securities class action (Jan 2025-May 2026 class period) alleging misleading Companion Animal statements
US companion-animal revenue -11% in Q1 2026 amid Zenrelia/Apoquel competition; guidance was cut
Debt/equity elevated from buybacks; the de-rate may be partly justified, not purely sentiment
catalyst: Q3 earnings plus evidence the OA-pain franchise returns to growth and litigation risk clarifies
suggested_trade: Spot, starter near the 52-week low ~$73 and scale in; longer-horizon quality-at-a-discount
key_risk: Librela safety/legal situation worsens or competitive share loss accelerates, validating the multiple compression
would_skip_if: New Librela adverse-event disclosures emerge or guidance is cut again
